name: 01 — Scrape & Match (Mon/Wed/Fri)
_note: SANITIZED snapshot of the LIVE n8n Cloud workflow (id ZZPsOF8vwttSIuZz). Cloud-native: Apify HTTP + Code + Supabase nodes (does NOT call the host agents). Runs Mon/Wed/Fri 08:00 IST (cron 30 2 * * 1,3,5). Pipeline: scrape (ATS + Apify Google) -> Quality Gate (drop senior/>5y/thin/off-target -> status 'filtered') -> insert -> score the 'scraped' backlog with a 6-dimension Gemini rubric (stack/seniority/location/compensation/evidence/mission) -> weighted-average match_score, >=60 'matched' else 'filtered', score_breakdown saved as JSONB. Scoring runs straight from the trigger (trigger -> Get Unscored Jobs), independent of the scrape/insert loop. Secrets redacted — replace YOUR_APIFY_API_TOKEN and YOUR_GEMINI_API_KEY before importing. Telegram uses $env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / $env.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID. Reference export — NOT auto-synced to cloud.

parameters.jsCode: const results=$input.all();const KW=["ai","ml","machine learning","genai","llm","nlp","data scientist","mlops","deep learning","generative","foundation model"];const hasAI=t=>{const l=(t||"").toLowerCase();return KW.some(k=>l.includes(k));};const clean=s=>{let x=s||"";try{x=decodeURIComponent(x);}catch(e){}return x.replace(/%20/gi," ").replace(/-/g," ").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim().replace(/\b\w/g,l=>l.toUpperCase());};const jobs=[];const seen=new Set();for(const item of results){const r=item.json||{};const url=r.url||"";if(!url)continue;let company="",atsType="";if(url.includes("boards.greenhouse.io")){const m=url.match(/boards\.greenhouse\.io\/([^\/]+)/);if(m){company=m[1];atsType="greenhouse";}}else if(url.includes("jobs.lever.co")){const m=url.match(/jobs\.lever\.co\/([^\/]+)/);if(m){company=m[1];atsType="lever";}}else if(url.includes("jobs.ashbyhq.com")){const m=url.match(/jobs\.ashbyhq\.com\/([^\/]+)/);if(m){company=m[1];atsType="ashby";}}if(!company||seen.has(url)||!hasAI(r.title||""))continue;seen.add(url);jobs.push({company:clean(company),role:(r.title||"").replace(/^Job Application for /,"").replace(/ at .+$/,""),jd_url:url,jd_text:(r.snippet||"").slice(0,2000),ats_type:atsType,location:"India",status:"scraped"});}return jobs.length?jobs.map(j=>({json:j})):[{json:{jd_url:"",status:"scraped"}}];
